notes: Your own food library. Search your saved foods and restaurants the forgiving way: كفتيريا or كافتيرا, shawarma or شاورما, or a typo or two all find the same food. Add where a food is from, and tap a restaurant to see what you usually order there. Meals from a photo or the Gemini Gem keep their parts, so next time you untick the ketchup in one tap and it's remembered; the day's log says what you left out. The same meal from the same place updates instead of being saved twice, and drinks always log under Drinks.
